sections.title: Special attacks and qualities mechanics
lines: Improved grab · After a claw hit, the crab can attempt a grapple as a free action without provoking attacks of opportunity. A successful check establishes a hold and lets it constrict.
Constrict · A successful grapple check deals 4d6+8 constrict damage.
Amphibious · The aquatic crab survives indefinitely on land.

sections.title: Encounters mechanics
lines: Wave guardian · The 107 HP crab attacks intruders in the membrane dome. While fighting it stays at least 5 feet from the walls whenever possible.

sections.title: Table notes
lines: Neutral. Intelligence shown as a dash. Toughness as a bonus feat. Space and reach are both 15 feet.
White Plume Mountain (2005 D&D 3.5 revision), Area 17, pp. 20–21. The adventure prints this full advanced stat block on p. 21.

sections.title: Base creature rules mechanics
lines: Improved grab · A claw hit allows a free grapple attempt without provoking attacks of opportunity. The scorpion uses the higher of Strength or Dexterity for the grapple check.
Constrict · A successful grapple check deals 1d6+4 automatic claw damage.
Sting poison · The sting carries poison. Fortitude DC 14. Both initial and secondary damage are 1d4 Constitution.

sections.title: Encounters mechanics
lines: Desert Terrace · Encounter Level 6. As soon as a character sets foot on this level, three Large Monstrous Scorpions surround the intruders and attack from all directions. Each has 32 HP. Each scorpion is CR 3.

Separate a victim · After establishing a grapple, a scorpion that wins another grapple check can pull the target 25 feet from the party as a standard action. Another scorpion can take its place. They fight to the death.

sections.title: Table notes
lines: The Large column leaves alignment unstated and shows Intelligence as a dash. No feats listed. Space 10 feet, reach 5 feet.
Base combat figures are from the 3.5 Monster Manual p. 287, as referenced by the adventure, and match the revised SRD Large Monstrous Scorpion.
White Plume Mountain (2005 D&D 3.5 revision), Area 26C, p. 27 supplies the encounter’s numbers and tactics.
